Approach to Handling and Protecting Personal Information # Cartridge Web (“CW”) is committed to the responsible management of personal information collected through its website (https://www.cartridgeweb.com). This document outlines our practices regarding the collection, use, and protection of personal data, ensuring transparency and security for all users.
Collection of Personal Information # When CW requests personal information, we will always inform you in advance about the purpose of collection, intended usage, and provide relevant contact information. Supplying personal information is entirely voluntary. However, declining to provide certain details may limit your access to specific services on our website.
Protection of Personal Information # CW employs robust security measures to safeguard your personal information against unauthorized access, loss, disclosure, or improper alteration. Our commitment is to maintain the integrity and confidentiality of your data at all times.
Use of Personal Information # Personal information provided to CW will only be used for the purposes previously communicated to you. Should we wish to use your information for any additional purposes, we will notify you in advance, giving you the option to refuse such use. Any statistical analysis conducted on our website will not include or utilize personal information.
Disclosure of Personal Information # CW does not share your personal information with third parties except in the following circumstances:
You have given explicit consent for disclosure. Disclosure is required to a third party under a non-disclosure agreement with CW, and you have been notified of the purpose. Responses to inquiries are handled by our affiliates or distributors. Disclosure is mandated by applicable laws or regulations. Use of Cookies # Cookies are small data files sent from our web server to your browser and may be stored on your device. While cookies do not identify users personally, they help us recognize your computer and tailor our website to your preferences. Disabling cookies may affect your ability to use certain features or services on our website.
Compliance with Laws and Regulations # CW adheres to all relevant laws, regulations, and standards concerning the protection of personal information provided to us.
